pages.text:
## Rick Allen - Loi Pinel
Rick was born in Augusta, Georgia, November 7, 1951. He attended Evans High School, Evans, Georgia, graduated 1969 with honors. Rick received the Georgia Society of Professional Engineers Certificate for outstanding scholarship, leadership, citizenship, and interest in the field of engineering.
Rick graduated 1973 from Auburn University School of Architecture and Fine Arts with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Building Construction. While at Auburn, Rick was a member of:
- Alpha Tau Omega Social Fraternity
- Sigma Lambda Chi National Construction Honorary Fraternity
- Student Member Construction Specifications Institute
In 1973, married the former Robin Reeve of Carrollton, Georgia and share four children; Jennifer Allen Green 35 (Tee), Andy Allen 32 (Betsy), Molly Allen Hargather 29 (Jamie), and Robin Anne Allen 27. He also has five grandchildren Hadley Green 10, Wyche Green 7, Hutton and Collier Green (twins) 6, and Hammond Hargather infant.
Since 1976, Rick has served as President and CEO of R. W. Allen & Associates, Inc., Construction Corporation, Augusta, Georgia.
